_: Copy this file to louise.config.json in Louise's folder to choose her library. Without one she uses <Hub>/50-AI/research, or her examples when there is no Hub. New research goes to the first root. A path may start with <Hub> (your Hub folder) or ~ (your home folder). port is her dashboard's port: keep it the same as probe.port in her agent.json, which is where the office looks for her (install-agent may have changed it), or leave it out to use that one.
_roots: A root may also say "council" (its council folder, default council) and "state" (its marathon-research state file, from the root, default marathon-research-state.json). Add more roots to put other research folders on her shelves, for example { "label": "Project research", "path": "~/Projects/my-app/research", "state": "../.claude/state/marathon-research-state.json" }.
